summary: Scoped prototype audit: no remaining Rules bypass found in emulator tests. All mutations are Admin-only; owner reads remain restricted to mobile data, web roots and answer-bearing packs deny every client. This is not production security certification or an audit of future W3-W5 endpoints.

resolvedFinding.issue: Prior published_question_packs rule exposed all fields for published status.
resolvedFinding.recommendation: Implemented deny-all client reads; W3 must supply an allowlisted server question projection.

attackOutcomes.public list: Denied for all web roots and full packs; guest users list denied.
attackOutcomes.unauthorized CRUD: Guest, owner, other user and admin-claim client CRUD denied on private roots.
attackOutcomes.update bypass: All creates and updates denied, including replacements of existing documents.
attackOutcomes.owner hijack create/update: Forged ownerUid and role payloads denied.
attackOutcomes.immutable timestamp: Changed expiry/creation denied to every client.
attackOutcomes.invalid types: Numeric owner and string expiry mutations denied.
attackOutcomes.oversized fields: 200KB string denied; all client writes unconditionally denied.
attackOutcomes.privilege escalation: Self-assigned user admin and admin-claim private access denied.
attackOutcomes.path traversal: Foreign/session path writes denied; callable safe-ID validation rejects slash paths.
attackOutcomes.clock manipulation: Past/future/overflow writes denied; callable TTL derived from server.
attackOutcomes.counter replay: Client counter writes denied; Admin minute/hour counters serialized in transactions.
attackOutcomes.mixed content: Foreign user/AI reads denied; full answer-bearing published packs denied.
attackOutcomes.orphaned subcollection: Private orphan descendants denied; existing mobile owner-only orphan reads intentional.
attackOutcomes.query compatibility: Mobile uses Admin-backed callables/local content; no direct full-pack reader exists.
attackOutcomes.validator pattern: No permissive client create/update rule; strict callable validation owns Admin mutations.
attackOutcomes.storage resources: No Storage rules or upload endpoint in this scope.
